_comment: DRAFT binds for the owner's Cleric. Confirm them before use. Slot ids match regions.alienware-2560x1600.draft.json. Only bar_q, bar_1, bar_2 and bar_e are enabled; the rest stay off until they can be calibrated or are confirmed. `run` still refuses this file until profile_hash pins a real calibrated profile.
_source: Owner's earlier project alienware-bazzite:~/Projects/aion2-cleric-macro, cleric_personal.json: the hotbar was read live on 2026-10-28 by matching each slot against the game's skill icons; the Skill window of 2026-11-09 shows the same key positions. Cooldowns come from that project's cleric_skills.json, an aion2data.com snapshot of game data 2026.10.28. Cast times, GCD, MP costs and effect durations are unknown and left at 0.
_not_carried_over: The macro's timing block (hold_min/max, action_gap_min/max) and every retry_jitter were dropped on purpose. This assist presses at a fixed spacing of 1/max_keys_per_sec with no jitter. Its 'interval' values are press cadences, not cooldowns, and were not used as cooldowns.

_excluded_keys.F6: Speed Scroll: the game's own auto-use keeps it up.
_excluded_keys.F1: Second potion: its effect was never confirmed in the macro.
_excluded_keys.BTN_LEFT: Earth's Retribution (damage, restores MP) is on left click. The key rule refuses mouse buttons, so it cannot be bound. Owner decision: rebind it to a key, or allow pointer input.

_choices_to_confirm: mode toggle with F8 on/off and F9 emergency stop mirrors the macro's F8/F9 (the safer default is hold-to-run). hot_hp 0.75 is the macro's Q threshold. hp_max/mp_max are the level-9 values from 2026-10-28; they only scale MP costs, which are all 0 here.

bar_q._skill: Q stack: Light of Regeneration (cooldown 30 s), Healing Light (6 s, from Lv 10). The 6 s is the shorter one, so tracking never blocks a usable press; the on-screen cooldown check decides the rest.
bar_q._note: UNRESOLVED: Q is a stack like E, and neither setting is safe until frames show how the slot looks after each press. With cooldown 6 it is under desync tracking. If a press leaves the slot reading ready (Light of Regeneration cast, Healing Light still usable), that counts as a miss. Below safe_hp no damage is pressed, so nothing resets the miss counter, and three such Q presses latch the assist off within about 15 s, while HP is low. Cooldown 0 is worse: upkeep runs before damage, so a slot that always reads ready would block all damage while HP is under hot_hp.

bar_1._skill: Debilitating Mark (cooldown 10 s); the macro opened with it.

bar_e._skill: E stack: Chain of Torment (20 s), Condemnation (3 s, needs Chain of Torment on the target, from Lv 8), Lightning Strike Scattershot (needs Stagger, from Lv 5). The game casts the first usable one.
bar_e._note: cooldown 0 on purpose: with a cooldown the desync latch would expect a cooldown sweep after every press, and a stack that casts Scattershot or Condemnation may not show one. With 0 it is pressed only while its slot reads ready, at most max_keys_per_sec. It has the lowest damage priority so 1 and 2 go first.

bar_3._skill: Radiant Recovery (cooldown 12 s, unlocks at Lv 12). Off until the owner confirms it is unlocked and it is added to the regions.

bar_4._skill: Bolt (cooldown 45 s, unlocks at Lv 14). Off until unlocked and calibrated.

bar_5._skill: Judgment Thunder (filler, no cooldown). Off: a slot without a cooldown look cannot be calibrated, and an uncalibrated slot is never pressed.

item_x._skill: Emergency Health Potion. The macro used it at HP <= 35% every 15 s; the real potion cooldown is unknown. Off until its slot is calibrated.

item_f5._skill: Courage Scroll (the macro used it once per 300 s while fighting). Off until its slot is calibrated.

item_f7._skill: Benediction Scroll (once per 300 s while fighting). Off until its slot is calibrated.
